reuse.why: Hooks into the existing getFillableCategories selection and mirrors getCategoriesWithTemplates, but copyPreviousMonth keeps its own exclusion list instead of using the shared selection.

duplication.why: The new #fixed exclusion is applied twice, once in getFillableCategories and once in copyPreviousMonth's own hidden/templated filter, extending an existing parallel copy of the exclusion rule.

placement.why: The helper sits in budget/actions.ts beside getCategoriesWithTemplates, where the tree decides which categories month-wide actions touch.

scope.why: Only the fixed-group helper, its two uses, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Each new exclusion still has to be added in two places (getFillableCategories and copyPreviousMonth), and the comment wrapping is awkward; the helper itself is clear.

bypasses_abstraction.where: copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts applies hidden/templated/fixed exclusions itself instead of going through getFillableCategories

disguised_duplication.where: The added check is the same fixed.has(...) test in both filters, not reshaped

one_place.where: The tag test is in getCategoriesInFixedGroups, but the exclusion is decided separately in getFillableCategories and in copyPreviousMonth's own filter
